_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate for ±2+ point moves in 12h windows makes HOLD the statistically honest default, and neither ETF flows nor stablecoin growth have broken the stalemate to confirm either a leg up toward Disbelief or a flush down toward Panic.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction while the narrative writer's bottoming thesis implies an eventual UP move; the split is real and the analyst's higher trust weight plus superior on-chain data awareness tips the consensus to HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows > 30 and stablecoin_growth > 45 with btc_momentum_30d holding > 45
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows stays < 10 AND vix > 75 with funding dropping below 0.001%
